items.note: Report 2 (line 573) now says the Vite proxy cannot reach Spring Boot and answers 502 with an empty plain-text body, matching Vite's proxy error handler (writeHead(502, {Content-Type: text/plain}).end()). Hint 1 (line 588) says "a body that is not JSON"; option B (line 613) says the empty plain-text body makes res.json() reject; option C (line 623) says "such as the proxy's plain-text 502"; artifact.md mirrors report 2 and hint 1. Executed on Node 24.2.0: new Response("", {status: 502, headers: {"content-type": "text/plain"}}).json() rejects with SyntaxError "Unexpected end of JSON input", so the original code still reaches catch and option C's else branch handles the 502 without parsing. Keyed answers unchanged (A1 d, A2 b, A3 c). Other loop-2 changes reviewed: the recap-gate CSS and the "Built safely" definition added to A1's static alternative introduce no technical claim. No new technical issue on this page; page-and-language (fb12d0c2) was also re-read: its new A1 "Note:" (a <button> inside a form submits it, and submission runs the browser checks) matches the earlier Chromium run (default type "submit", invalid event fired on Enter), so no loop-2 report is written for it.

Re-verified on these bytes: Activity 3 (line 555) states VITE_API_URL is /api and the Vite dev proxy forwards it to Spring Boot, so the request is same-origin and CORS cannot block it; the option C explanation's "fetch fulfills on 400 and 502" therefore holds. Recap line 664 says fetch rejects on a network failure or a CORS-blocked cross-origin response and otherwise fulfills even on 400 or 502; cheat-sheet line 670 says a rejection means no readable response; the Using Fetch source note (line 690) names the CORS failure. Earlier Chromium runs on real local servers: same-origin 502 fulfilled, cross-origin 502 without CORS headers rejected with "TypeError: Failed to fetch", cross-origin 400 with CORS headers fulfilled. Keyed C remains the only correct option.
